description: The Power Station Dictionary is a public crosswalk for power plant identifiers and associated metadata. Its GitHub repository documents how plant names and IDs from different data packages are mapped to the same facility. Users can match generation records across sources and extract harmonised plant attributes for the facilities listed. Geographic coverage follows the plants contributed to the dictionary and is not a claim of complete worldwide coverage. The README links its site and contribution route, while GitHub metadata states MIT licensing. A limitation is that uncertain or missing aliases can join the wrong plants or leave duplicate units; every high-impact match needs a source check. The dictionary can help assemble an electricity asset inventory for grid simulation. The related catalogue OpenStreetMap power infrastructure records are a separate mapping source and do not establish this crosswalk. No plant table or dataset was downloaded.
name: Power Station Dictionary plant crosswalk
notes: G7 G7-1646. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability.
